terms.gloss: a clay jar with two handles, for wine, oil and the like
evidence: Plaut. Cas. 121: dabitur tibi amphora ūna et ūna sēmita
terms.comment: Greek ἀμφορεύς. Also a liquid measure.

terms.gloss: a large jar, above all for wine
evidence: Plaut. Amph. 429: Cadus erat vīnī, inde implēvī hirneam.

phrases.latin: dabitur tibi amphora ūna et ūna sēmita, fōns ūnus, ūnum ahēnum et octō dōlia
phrases.english: you’ll be given one jar and one path, one spring, one copper and eight vats

phrases.latin: Cadus erat vīnī, inde implēvī hirneam.
phrases.english: There was a jar of wine; I filled a jug from it.

sources: Lewis & Short: amphora · Lewis & Short: cadus
